applies_why: The judge text treats the cited Isaiah 7:14 points as answered rather than as unanswered witnesses.
quote: Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge says the relevant points were answered and does not count any verse as an unanswered witness, it complies with K-G4.
